name: Sweet Kaaram Coffee
summary: Created by Reshma Ghatala, Sweet Kaaram Coffee is a slice of life series. Three women of different generations living in the same house attempt to put themselves before the people they are bound by for the first time. What follows is a journey of fun, fumbling and finding self.

name: Deer Squad
summary: Kai, Lola, Rammy and Bobbi are four heroic young deer that protect the animals who live in Central Forest and the people living in Platinum City.

name: Manhunt: The Child Snatcher
summary:
In this two-part drama documentary, first-hand testimonies tell the story of one of the UK's largest murder investigations: hunting an unknown serial killer obsessed with abducting and murdering young girls. Left in the killer's wake are devastated families and a huge police inquiry piecing together the disturbing puzzle.

Featuring emotional accounts from parents who lost loved ones, interviews with officers who worked tirelessly for decades to crack the case, and taped interviews with the murderer himself – these two episodes offer a definitive overview into a series of chilling crimes that shocked the nation.

name: Little Lola Visits the City
summary: Join Lola for fun adventures in the city as she discovers skateboards, fire trucks, how to cross the street, take a taxi and more! This series introduces the city environment and activities in a safe and enjoyable way with Lola and her friends.

name: Confess Your Love
summary: Xu Huanxi, a modern girl, drank her sorrows because of a broken relationship, and woke up to find that she was actually in an ancient wedding room. I thought it was a dream and finally married a male god, but I didn't expect that the reality is that I have traveled through time, and the groom is still a strange playboy prince Song Kuo! Xu Huanxi wanted to go back to modern times by drinking, but she actually traveled to a country that banned alcohol.

name: Puppy School for Guide Dogs
summary: In Puppy School for Guide Dogs we meet the remarkable puppies across guide and support dog organisations throughout the UK. Puppies who will provide life changing assistance and companionship, helping individuals to live with greater dignity and independence. Throughout the series we'll follow the dogs' stories, seeing jeopardy; emotion; and joy, as they transform the lives of the people they've been sent to help and their families.

name: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
summary:
On 21 December 1988, flight Pan Am 103 was en route from Heathrow to JFK when a bomb exploded in its hold over the small Scottish town of Lockerbie, killing 270 people, including 43 British citizens and 190 Americans. It was the worst ever terror attack on British soil and the first major one on US citizens.

The Bombing of Pan Am 103 focuses on the investigation into the crash on both sides of the Atlantic and the devastating effect it had on the small town and the families who lost loved ones. From the initial exhaustive search for evidence on the ground in Scotland, via the US and Malta to the trial at Camp Zeist in 2000, the drama takes us right up to the most recent indictment at the end of 2022.

name: Anne og Anders i Canada
summary: Anne and Anders travel from British Columbia in the west to Nova Scotia in the east. They try to understand the huge, multicultural country and meet some of the 200,000 Danes and their descendants who have helped shape the country.

name: Good Night World
summary: A shut-in older brother. A high-achieving younger brother. A father who is not respected by his own children.A mother who neglects her own household. This is a broken family, and none of its members know that they are all players in an online game.

name: Wil Cwac Cwac
summary: Wil Cwac Cwac is a duckling who lives in a farmhouse with his mother and father and has many big adventures with the folks and friends who live in and around their little Welsh village.

name: Avenger Penguins
summary: Three motorcycle riding penguins fight evil genius Caractacus P. Doom, a mad scientist intent on world domination.

name: Mission Invisible
summary: In order to save their beloved school from the wild plots hatched by their evil teacher, four friends have formed a spy network! Armed with gadgets such as the super-sonic-reactor skateboard, bullet-proof chewing gum or laughing gas pop-corn they will do anything to save their little world.

name: Fleabag Monkeyface
summary: A living, breathing, farting embodiment of every gross-out you've ever imagined, half-monkey half-boy Fleabag Monkeyface gets into disgusting adventures with his creators Gene and Gerald as they fend off the dastardly machinations of Dr. Dirk Spamflex.

previousepisode.name: When Earwax Attacks / Attack of the 50 Ft. Baby

name: El payaso Plim Plim, un héroe del corazón
Farm Dreams
summary: Farming expert and influencer Indy Srinath encounters aspiring farmers hoping to make their dreams a reality.

name: Mother, May I Murder?
summary: What happens when nature's strongest bond between mother and child turns toxic? ID, explores exactly what happens when this connection turns deadly. In seven shocking stories, lust, greed, and jealousy drive mothers and their children to conspire with - and against - each other to kill. With gripping eye witness accounts and powerful home and police archives, this new ID series pulls back the dark underbelly of American family life to unmask manipulation and murder. From the extraordinary coast-to-coast crimes of a notorious mother-son grifter duo to shocking acts of revenge in small town America, Mother, May I Murder? reveals that the ties that bind families can also rip them apart.

name: ШКЛТ
summary: A sketch show about schoolchildren with the most incredible, fantastical plots in a variety of formats. SHKLT is an almanac of short sketches, including narrative stories, musical sketches, and trailers for fictional films. They combine humor, adventure, relatable situations, and educational elements.

name: Farming for Love
summary: Five Canadians searching for their soulmates open up their farms – and their hearts – to a select group of urban singles.

previousepisode.name: I Want Us to be Together

name: The Betoota Advocate Presents
summary: Fronted by Editor At Large Errol Packet and Editor Clancy Overall, the pair dig deep into the controversies that shaped our nation. Across four episodes, corruption, money, religion and tribalism are key themes, with no stone left unturned to get to the crux of the headline. Australia has a history and sometimes it's not pretty and The Betoota Advocate Presents doesn't sugarcoat it. And it's why Aussies love them.

previousepisode.name: Australia's Biggest Racing Scandal: Fine Cotton

name: Boy Boy Montreal
summary: Through the confessions of six professional pornstars, this humorous documentary series offers viewers an insider's look into Montreal's gay porn industry, a major hub on the international scene. Meet the actors, cult filmmakers, specialists in sex health, and model's entourage revealing all the secrets about the pornstar life.

name: My Personal Weatherman
summary: Mizuki Segasaki is an up-and-coming weather forecaster who seems like a mild-mannered man, but beneath the placid surface he is a tyrant at home. This fact is well known to pornographic manga artist Yoh Tanada, who lives with him. Although Segasaki provides for all of Tanada's expenses, the only condition for this deal is that Tanada needs to obey Segasaki's every wish!

name: Kiseki: Dear to Me
summary: Bai Zong Yi a young man who aspires to be a doctor, is forced to take the injured gangster, Fan Ze Rui to his own house and take care of the latter. As time goes by, the two get familiar and fall in love with each other. However, because of a gangster fight, Zong Yi takes the rap for Ze Rui and ends up in jail. The two are so torn apart, their friends, Eddy and Chen Yi also go their separate ways. Four years later, fate reunites the four of them again. They have to face past mistake and regret to get their happiness back.

name: Oscar's Orchestra
summary: In a dystopian future of 2743, Thaddius Vent, dictator of the futuristic city of New Vienna, had banned all music. Young adventurous Rebecca helps Oscar, the talking piano, find a band of fellow instruments and lead a rebellion.

name: Pocahontas: Princess of the American Indians
summary: Pocahontas embarks on a journey around America, where she visits the various Native tribes, learns their different ways, and shares with them her life lessons.

name: Ferdy, die Ameise
summary: Ferdy is a black ant who solves his problems in every episode with his intelligence and the help of his friends.

previousepisode.name: A Day in the Life of a Water-drop

name: LOL: Last One Laughing Argentina
summary: The successful comedy format LOL: Last One Laughing arrives in Argentina! This social experiment hosted by the iconic Susana Giménez will seek to find the next champion of comedy and crown the first winner of LOL Argentina. Whoever laughs, loses, and whoever makes it until the end and provokes more laughs from their rivals will be the winner of the season.

name: Celebridade
summary: A successful businesswoman in the music industry sees her life fall apart after a young and mysterious woman starts work as her secretary. The scheming girl is totally obsessed by the famous businesswoman and she tries to steal everything from her, including her career.

name: Невероятные приключения Алины
summary: Alina Troyanskaya writes adventure novels and has not left her house for several years. Her home resembles a fortress from the fairy tale about the three little pigs. But one day, strangers kidnap the cautious writer and force her to search for Pugachev's treasure along the route described in Troyanskaya's latest novel. The treasure hunters are sure that Alina will lead them to the treasure. They do not suspect that the treasure is guarded by a cannibal - in a trap from which there is no escape...

name: Le Miroir de l'eau
summary: Antoine Marange returns to his home near Aix-en-Provence after sailing around the world, only to learn that the girl he had loved twenty-five years earlier, Isaure Castella, has drowned in the lake 'Waters Mirrors'. Her drowning was suspicious and Antoine's return unveils a lot of mysteries.

name: Patrik Pacard
summary: The story is about a German boy and his family getting into an espionage story whilst on holiday in Norway.

name: Couch Talk with Captain Lee and Kate
summary: Fan-favorites and longtime friends Captain Lee Rosbach and Kate Chastain breakdown the biggest moments of the week on Bravo.

name: A Cotswold Farm Shop
summary: Behind the scenes at the family-run Gloucester Service Station in the Cotswolds.

name: Deadlocked: How America Shaped the Supreme Court
summary: Weighing in on all rights protected by the Constitution, the nine unelected Justices of the Supreme Court have the final word on issues that impact our democracy and daily lives, including the right to privacy and access to the ballot. Deadlocked premieres at a profoundly consequential time, as Americans grapple with a Supreme Court drastically remade by former President Donald Trump; the historic confirmation of Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson; the unprecedented leak from inside the Court's chambers; and the aftershock of the landmark Dobbs decision's effective reversal of Roe v. Wade. To understand this critical moment, the series travels back to the 1950s when Chief Justice Earl Warren heralded an era of progressive legal decisions spurred by the nation's changing values, paving the zigzagging path the country is still walking today. Deadlocked reveals how the Supreme Court's ideological balance has shifted over the years to reflect the hopes – and fears – of American citizens, exploring the interconnectedness between the Court's and the nation's future.

name: The Greenhouse
summary: Two siblings join a private boarding school for gifted future leaders.

name: Broadcast Rookie
summary: Due to fate and coincidence, two young people cooperated to live broadcast the sale of unsalable houses (the former tenant committed suicide in the house because of love).

name: Monsters in the Forbidden City: Secret of Time Prison
Контуженный
summary:
The commander of the SOBR, Major Dmitry Chistyakov, loses consciousness while performing the next task. The consequences of a traumatic brain injury received in a "hot spot" are making themselves felt. The medical board recognizes him unfit for further service.

Chistyakov cannot imagine himself as a security guard or the head of a warehouse and turns to his old comrade, lieutenant colonel ugro, with a request to arrange him for the police. No one needs a "fit" man there. But Chistyakov has a gift: during seizures, he can see other people's memories, you just need to find a thing that was dear to the owner. This information helps Chistyakov to restore the picture of the crime and more than compensates for the lack of experience in the investigation.

name: Joia Rara
summary: The telenovela tells the story of Franz and Amélia, who fall in love, although they are from different social classes, and that love is born Pérola. However, they have an obstacle to be happy: Franz's father, Ernest, who will do anything to separate Franz from Amélia and take custody of his granddaughter and will therefore frame Amélia, putting her behind from jail unjustly for thinking that a son should have someone of his social class as his wife. The light of this dysfunctional family is Pérola, daughter of Franz and Amélia. She is a very valuable and special child, a fact that can be explained by the monks: she would be the reincarnation of Ananda. Pérola's mission is to teach people to love unconditionally, and this will light up their grandfather's heart with tenderness and affection.

name: The Michael Blackson Show
summary: A dashiki-wearing African teacher chasing the American Dream struggles with culture shock as he navigates delinquent teenagers and eccentric colleagues at his new school.

name: Animal Stories
summary: Animal Stories takes a humorous look at the lives, loves and concerns of the animal kingdom, viewed from a child's perspective.

name: Lioness
summary: Released from prison ten years after being framed for fraud committed by her husband, a woman tries to piece together the complex puzzle left by her husband's death, still without her home or custody of her children.

name: Drug Lords: The Takedown
summary: Dramatic accounts of how the world's biggest and deadliest drug lords were hunted down and taken out, all told by special agents and cartel insiders.

name: Murder Detective with Graham Hill
summary: Murder Detective with Graham Hill introduces former Surrey Police senior detective and criminologist Graham Hill to Crime + Investigation's true crime-loving audience as the Murder Detective. In each episode, Graham Hill pairs his detective methodology with forensic science and insider knowledge to provide audiences with his expert understanding of how the cases were finally cracked. The episodes will also include key witness testimonies, new interviews, forensic and psychological experts, and archive footage, taking viewers into the investigation to see the modern crime-solving techniques.

name: Ultimate Wedding Planner
summary: A whirlwind of love, chaos and creativity as aspiring planners showcase their skills at real weddings. For the brave couples, will it be wedded bliss or a nuptial nightmare?

name: Karen Carney's Leaders of the Pack
summary: The incredible achievements of female footballers.

name: The Brothers Brannagan
summary: Private eye series. Portrayed by Mark Roberts and Steve Dunne, these two investigators headquarter at a lush Phoenix motel. When not working, they like to lie beside the luxurious swimming a pool, get a suntan and ogle the girls. Mike is impulsive, romantic and literary. Bob is judicious, hard-headed, methodical. Together, they are the Brothers Brannagan, the unbeatable team of private investigators which debuted in the 1960 fall. The weekly CBS Films series is set in the Mountain Shadows resort hotel in Scottsdale, near Phoenix, Arizona, which the two brothers use as a base of operations both business and social. The brothers are amiable and relaxed, but rugged and virile

name: СуперИвановы
summary: The women of the Ivanov family have an amazing gift — each with her own. Darina sees through people, her mother Tamara Petrovna knows how to brew potions, and the viewer has yet to learn the gift of her teenage daughter Katya. And only Darina's husband, Valera, a school physics teacher, remains faithful to science. Soon word of mouth spreads rumors about the magic family, and the Ivanovs begin to help others in solving their everyday problems. But will their abilities help to sort out their own family stories?.

name: The Galloping Remaining Year
summary: Faced with his long-time friend Alzheimer's, Zhang Xiao Yao decides not to wait any longer and together with him goes to complete the "bucket list" they made years ago and fulfil all the delayed promises he made to him.

name: Телохранители
summary: Yashcher, Yurok and Tucha decide to make money on a commercial tournament in fights without rules before flying to the World Championship, which is why they are excluded from the national team. The boxers have dinner in a restaurant in the capital, where a conflict ensues between them and the protection of an influential lawyer. Having demonstrated their professional skills, the heroes find themselves in the police. Impressed by their skill, the lawyer offers the boxers a deal: go to prison or become his bodyguards.

name: Cross Country Cake Off
summary: Cross Country Cake Off invites cake makers from across the country to compete for the title of Canada's Best Cake Maker.

name: China's Wild Empire
summary:
Dense and mysterious forests, vertical mountains, sweeping deserts and thriving wetlands… While Central Asia is densely populated, it's also one of the most vast - and last - unexplored wilderness regions on Earth. Its distinctly sublime landscapes boast the highest biodiversity of anywhere outside the tropics.

Our insider, exclusive access - along with our global perspective - propels viewers into Asia's magnificent bounty of rare, charismatic wildlife through intimately told stories about unique animals. Following the superb and unprecedented approach of The Frozen Kingdom of the Snow Leopard we embark with three more iconic animals as their true dramas unfold before our eyes. And, for the first time, an international crew is on the ground to capture behavior in previously unseen locations in China.

name: Miseducation
summary: After a public humiliation, a wannabe influencer enrolls in a small-town university, where she aspires to regain her social status.

name: San Francisco Sounds: A Place in Time
summary: San Francisco Sounds: A Place in Time celebrates the musical and artistic renaissance that exploded in the Bay Area from the mid-sixties into the mid-seventies. Featuring the music of Jefferson Airplane, Janis Joplin, the Grateful Dead, Steve Miller, and many more.

name: Does Murder Sleep?
summary: When we sleep, we are at our most vulnerable. Sometimes crimes occur when a few or even all key characters are fast asleep. These stories tap into the primal fear, present since childhood, of what happens once we shut our eyes.

name: Football Pass
summary: Football preview with host Amy Irons.

name: Common Knowledge
summary: Two teams answer practical, everyday questions that everyone should know. Questions are part of everyday from Kitchen, Good Eats, Housekeeping, Tools and many more. For example do you know you can keep your bathroom mirrors from fogging up by cleaning them with what?

previousepisode.name: Cabanes Family vs Chi Town Boys

name: Missing Persons Investigation
summary: Go behind the scenes with investigators across the country as they battle the clock to find lost loved ones in the emotional new series Missing Persons Investigation.

name: Mission to Burnley
summary: Mission to Burnley is an epic story about the rebirth of one of England's most historic clubs, Burnley FC under the ownership of a charismatic group of American owners and the leadership of Vincent Kompany in a season of footballing evolution.

name: Live to 100: Secrets of the Blue Zones
summary: Travel around the world with author Dan Buettner to discover five unique communities where people live extraordinarily long and vibrant lives.

name: Kaiser
summary: A homicide detective who is scared of blood? Discover many other quirks of Detective Kaiser Chowdhury as he investigates a double murder which turns out to be a lot more.

name: Take Me to the Opera
summary: Zeinab Badawi meets the stars of the world of opera.

name: Demons & Saviors
summary: Investigating the conspiracy behind Christina Boyer, the woman convicted of murdering her three-year-old daughter; thirty years into a life sentence, Christina still proclaims her innocence.

name: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
summary: From the imaginations of the Turtles themselves, Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles puts individual spotlights on the four pizza-loving brothers, challenging them like never before!

name: Croisement Gaza Bd St Germain
summary: Years after falling in love with Paris, Yaël and Youssouf find themselves face to face in a tunnel on the border between Gaza and Israel.

name: Air Academy
summary: Join the Air Academy flight crew on their perilous adventures and heroic rescues. This anime series is a combination of traditional animation and computer-aided animation.

previousepisode.name: One of Our Satellites Is Missing

name: 1001 Nights
summary: You've heard of Sinbad, Aladdin, and Ali Baba? You've got 998 more stories to go! 1001 Nights is an animated series bringing these tales to you in a way that will keep you coming back for more.

name: Fright Krewe
summary: An ancient prophecy and a Voodoo Queen put misfit teens in charge of saving New Orleans from the biggest demonic threat it's faced in almost two centuries. But, honestly? Saving the world might be easier than becoming friends.

name: Lidia's Italy
summary: A travelogue-cooking show, featuring Lidia Bastianich's journeys through Italy and the recipes she encountered.

name: God. Family. Football.
summary: God. Family. Football. follows former football player and high school football coach Denny Duron, who has come out of a 30-year retirement to lead the football program he founded at Evangel Christian Academy in Shreveport, Louisiana, back to national prominence. With the perennial high school football powerhouse—14 State Championships in the last 20 years—coming off their worst season in school history, redemption is everyone's goal. As the team faces struggle and triumph both on and off the field, they are united by Coach Denny's formula for success: "God first, family second, and football third."

name: Rotten Ralph
summary: Animation about 'the meanest cat in the whole wide world' and the young girl who loves him. Based on children's books by Jack Gantos and Nicole Rubel.

name: Cheetah in August
summary: A riveting story about a former high school track athlete who's distorted views on love, negatively affects the people closest to him.

name: Черное облако
summary: Twenty-year-old Olya is not distinguished by an easy character. Many who know her say that Olya is evil. Olya goes to a psychologist and during sessions with him she tries to "give room for her anger", "let her anger out". Olya tells the psychologist about all the people who infuriate her, and wishes them death in terrible agony. A teacher at the institute, best friend, boyfriend, father, mother ... All of them are very annoying Olya. And suddenly they all begin to die one by one under strange, inexplicable circumstances. Olya is at a loss as to what is going on.

name: Takeshi's Castle
summary: Worldwide sensation Takeshi's Castle returns after 34 years! Popular games are revived on a larger scale and new, terrifying obstacles appear one after another. The lord of the castle, Beat Takeshi, entrusts Bananaman to protect it. Subaru Kimura is the attack force's new leader. The elite team gathers to bring down the revived Takeshi's Castle. The greatest battle in history begins!

name: La Peste
summary:
We are in 2030, in a society where today's fears and concerns strangely resonate.
This company is just coming out of the wave of covid epidemics. And the plague she encounters is much more formidable...
While we have learned to live with the seasonal variants of covid, we discover in this southern city a new variant of the plague bacillus called YP2.
For lack of treatment, the central government will decide, in order to spare the rest of the country, to close the city - and then apply a mysterious "Plan D" of which we will gradually discover the monstrous springs.
Based on the work of Albert Camus.

name: Haisukûru! Kimengumi
summary: This is the story of five students who make up a crazy and unique group (the gang of the funny faces) and, in an incredible twist of luck, they befriend the cutest girl in school. Of course, they will enter into competition with many groups in their school, where teachers are tricky and sometimes clueless, where they can still defy the laws of nature to win sports tournaments and where you can still be childish, Anything could happen in this high school.

name: Dr. Jackie
summary: Using role-playing, primal scream therapy, ink-blot tests and yes, even puppets, Dr. Jackie is helping her funny, famous and fabulous "friends" navigate the rocky road of mental health.

name: Kriminalarkivet med Pops och Lampers
summary: Crime journalist Lasse Lampers shows both well-known and never-shown clips and talks about the pictures with the host André Pops.

name: Go Fishing
summary: A fantastic series showing keen angler, John Wilson fishing various locations and techniques.

name: Karate Schaf
summary: Trico is an enthusiastic sheep who loves to share new objects and ideas with the rest of the flock. This causes ruckus in the mountain pastures, which all inevitably end up at Wanda's expense, a tough ewe whose job is to keep the sheep safe. Not a small feat, especially when Wolf is always lurking, waiting to make the most of this newfound chaos.

previousepisode.name: Stronger Together / Reward Points / Animal Tracks

name: The Wild Sides
summary: In the extreme landscape of Mashatu in Botswana, all animal families' paths cross; each one's plot is affected by the next. Elephants, cheetahs, leopards, jackals, and baboons live together as their home experiences drought, flood, and abundance.

name: Horrible Histories
summary: Learn about different time periods in this animated series based on the Scholastic books by Terry Deary. An adventurous trio learns valuable lessons with the help of famous characters from the past.

name: Marido en Alquiler
summary: Griselda Carrasco is a humble woman, but rich in morals and principles. She dedicates her life to the well-being of her three children and grandson. As a single parent, she learned to be a handyman to support her family. She neglects her appearance because of the harsh reality that surrounds her and her working conditions. However, she is very proud of her line of work. Her ex-husband, Jose Salinas, was seemingly lost at sea, but reappears fifteen years later and will try to claim his place. Destiny leads Griselda to Reinaldo Ibarra, an honorable man, despite his social status. He is married to Teresa Cristina, but will be delighted with Griselda's essence, and he will gradually discover that his wife hides a dark secret. Griselda's life will change the moment she wins the lottery and becomes a millionaire overnight. She crosses paths with Teresa Cristina, who will do anything possible to destroy her, especially when she realizes she is losing her husband and daughter.

name: Drag Heals
summary: Drag Heals is a hybrid stage workshop and documentary TV series that follows eight drag artists over an intensive ten day workshop to build their own show. In each workshop, a guest coach joins stage director Tracey Erin Smith in exploring soul-deep story sharing techniques as well as the unique talents and skills required from a drag performer.

previousepisode.name: Drag Heals at the Paradise Theatre

name: Face to Face with David
summary: David Oulton interviews guests from the worlds of entertainment, business, politics and more.

name: Jungle de Ikou
summary: Natsumi, a young student from Japan gains the powers of Mii, the well-endowed fertility goddess of a tribal culture. Natsumi and her friends must save the Earth from ultimate destruction by a "god of ruin".

name: Слей шоу
summary:
How can a young person navigate the maelstrom of information, whom to listen to, and how to understand the topic? In the new Slay Show on Suspilne, we will talk about trigger topics with young audiences in the format of vlogs. 
The host Mariia Tuchka aka TUCHA presents the show for those who want to understand what is happening and how to respond to current and discussed topics.
In each episode, the host Mariia Tuchka will collect the most resonant topics for young people and reveal them at different levels. The programme will include short comments from experts and "people's polls".

previousepisode.name: Ці роботи НЕ ЗАБЕРЕ ШІ: чому бути сантехніком, електриком чи механіком з «ПТУ» тепер престижно?

name: Dating Unlocked
summary: In Dating Unlocked, hopeful romantics from the LGBTQ2S+ community move beyond curated social media and dating profiles to find love in real life, and potentially share the key to their hearts. From the traditional to more radical, there are daters from all walks of life who share the same goal - to find a hook-up, a date or their one and only.

name: KCSI: Smoking Gun
summary: In the scene of a cleverly evolving crime, find out the smoking gun that points to the culprit! A new program that empathizes with the pain of victims and showcases the importance and the role of forensic science through vivid stories of forensic investigations that uncover hidden truths.

name: Comedy Qweens
summary: Comedian Jonny McGovern shines the spotlight on some of today's hottest LGBTQ+ comics.

name: Kekkon Yoteibi
summary: "Married at 26" "First child at 27" "Second child at 29"... She always just assumed that's the way things would go... 28-year-old Kawai Yoshiko is still single. She has a broken heart a few days before her 29th birthday. On the way home, she runs into her colleague, Yuuki-san. Yoshiko cannot help telling him about what happened just before. Then Yuuki-san suddenly offers Yoshiko to get married with him a year later only if...

name: B.O.
summary: In this workplace comedy series, a cowardly police chief struggles to earn the respect of his squad.

previousepisode.name: Corra que o Suzano Vem Aí

name: Eckhart
summary: The adventures of a young farm mouse and his friends and family.

previousepisode.name: Goodbye to the Endless Journey and Blink

name: Hong Kong
summary: Rod Taylor portrays Glenn Evans, a newspaperman assigned to the Far East city. American foreign correspondent Glenn Evans is embroiled in intrigue and adventure as he pursues the news in the British Crown Colony from which the "Hong Kong" series draws its title.

name: Death's Game
summary: Death's Game will tell the story of a man who gets more than one second chance at life after facing death.

previousepisode.name: Don't Go Looking For Death. Death Will Come Find You.

name: MEAC/SWAC Challenge Kickoff
summary: The Cricket MEAC/SWAC Challenge is an annual game that features teams from the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference (MEAC) and the Southwestern Athletic Conference (SWAC). Launched in 2005 and played on Labor Day Weekend, the matchup was held for its first three years at historic Legion Field in Birmingham, Ala. In 2008, the event moved to Citrus Bowl Stadium in Orlando, Fla. In 2016 and 2017 the event was hosted at campus sites. Since 2018 the Challenge has been held at Atlanta's Georgia State University's Center Parc Stadium.

previousepisode.name: Alabama A&M Bulldogs vs. Howard Bison

name: Duke's Mayo Classic
summary: The Duke's Mayo Classic (known before 2020 as the Belk College Kickoff) is an annual college football game played on the opening weekend of the college football season in Charlotte at Bank of America Stadium, home of the Carolina Panthers.

name: Camping World Kickoff
summary: The Camping World Kickoff is an annual college football game played on the opening weekend of the college football season in Orlando, Florida at Camping World Stadium. The game, a collaboration between Florida Citrus Sports and ESPN Events, debuted in 2016 with a Labor Day game between Ole Miss and Florida State.

previousepisode.name: LSU Tigers vs. Florida State Seminoles

name: Aflac Kickoff Game
summary: The Aflac Kickoff Game is an annual series of college football games played on the opening weekend of the NCAA Division I FBS season in Atlanta, Georgia. Organized by the Peach Bowl, the event coincides with Labor Day weekend in the United States. From its inception in 2008 until 2016, it was held at the Georgia Dome. The Georgia Dome's replacement, Mercedes-Benz Stadium, began hosting the games starting in 2017. Since 2012, there have been occasional doubleheaders in the series.

name: Aer Lingus College Football Classic Ireland
summary:
Aer Lingus College Football Classic Ireland began initially in 1988 as part of a promotional campaign to mark the Dublin millennium celebrations. Dubbed the Emerald Isle Classic, it was the first NCAA-sanctioned American college football game played in Europe. The game was played at Lansdowne Road in Dublin, Ireland in the years 1988 and 1989. The event was first proposed and arranged by Aidan J. Prendergast and Jim O'Brien. Prendergast, who was a former president of the Irish American Football Association conceived the idea of bringing a major NCAA game to Ireland in the mid-1980s and started pitching the idea on both sides of the Atlantic. Prendergast promoted both the 1988 and 1989 games. 

The game was intended as an annual event to attract some of the 40 million Americans of Irish descent back to Ireland. College teams with particularly Irish or Catholic background were chosen in an effort to attract Irish nationals to the games.

previousepisode.name: University of North Carolina (UNC) vs. Texas Christian University (TCU)

name: FCS Kickoff
summary: The FCS Kickoff is an annual college football game played on the Saturday before the opening weekend of the college football season. The game showcases teams from the NCAA Division I Football Championship Subdivision (FCS). For the game's first three editions, it was played at campus sites; since 2017, the game has been played at a neutral site, the Cramton Bowl in Montgomery, Alabama.

previousepisode.name: East Texas A&M Lion vs. Mercer Bears

name: Vegas Kickoff Classic
summary: The Vegas Kickoff Classic is an annual college football game played on the opening weekend of the college football season in Paradise at Allegiant Stadium since August 2021.

name: Favorite Places
summary: Favorite Places takes viewers on a personal tour through some of North America's most interesting cities-and in each city, our guide is a prominent member of the LGBT community.

name: Tellus
summary: Tellus, a Finnish environmental group led by Eevi Forsman, use increasingly radical means to "save the earth". They are pursued by Taneli Lokka, an experienced police detective, who tries to save the earth in his own personal way.

name: Mulher de Fases
summary: Grace is a 30-something divorcee. But finding a mate isn't an easy task...and unlike the fairy tale, the prince often turns into a frog--not the other way around. This comedy series follows Grace as she juggles potential love interests with the support of her overprotective mother Hilda, her best friend Selma, and Selma's pre-teen daughter Tereza.

name: If God Is Willing and da Creek Don't Rise
summary: In 2006, director Spike Lee created an astonishing record of the cataclysmic effects of Hurricane Katrina on the city of New Orleans with his epic award-winning documentary, When the Levees Broke. Five years later, Lee returns to New Orleans, to see how the ambitious plans to reinvent the Crescent City were playing out.

name: Libby, Are You Home Yet?
summary: Tells the story of Libby Squire, a 21-year-old student, who was abducted and murdered walking home from a club in her university city of Hull in 2019. Libby's disappearance sparked the largest manhunt in Humberside Police history, which culminated in the arrest of a local man who had been leading a double life.

name: Pillow Talk
summary: A look at the relationships of Ryan, a tortured bachelor who is trying to stay in "the light" in a world where casual sex is plentiful.

previousepisode.name: Shri Ram is crowned king of Ayodhya

name: Pahlevanan
summary: The moral stories of a group of champions (Pahlevanan) living in Kharazm city in the 13th century.

name: Dios Inc.
summary: Dr. Salvador Pereyra has returned from a 10-year journey to the Middle East with a mind-blowing discovery: the tomb of Marduk, creator of the concept of God and whose teachings gave rise to the world's religions. But when his work is plagiarized by a dangerous sect, it's up to Salvador and a young sci-fi writer to stop the cult before it can spread.

name: Héroes cotidianos
summary: A hero is not someone who helps without fear--it's someone who helps despite it. This deeply moving series chronicles the stories of ordinary people doing extraordinary things, from the women who offer relief to illegal immigrants to a couple of retired teachers who bring the wonders of astronomy to poor children.

name: Až po uši
summary: Love triangles intertwine and converge in this look at complex sexual relationships in contemporary central Europe.

name: The Story of My Parents' Youth
summary: The story takes place in the 1960s. The second son of the Mo family, Mo Chengming couldn't find a job in Beijing and decides to follow his brother Mo Zhi to Inner Mongolia. However while his brother is at Hulunbuir, he goes to Ordos City where he found a job and married a Mongolian lady called Keng La. Chengming is musically talented since young, and by chance he joined the Mongol revolutionary cultural troupe. However at this Mo Zhi accidentally injured someone and escapes to Nanjing, where he was caught by the police. Sang Zi, the third sister of Mo family, leaves Nanjing and comes to Inner Mongolia. Sang Zi is skilled in volleyball and dancing, and she was sent to the Sonid Right Banner's cultural troupe. Mo Qingshan, the fourth son of Mo family, follows Mo Zhi who just came out of prison to Inner Mongolia, and also begin his own life there. Many years later, the children of Mo family found their own home and family in Inner Mongolia.

name: Lovely Ladies Dorm
summary: Five modern women live together in one roof as they deal with their families, career, and men and explore their colorful sex lives.

name: Fuchun Mountain Residence‎
summary: Xu Jia Fu's father devoted himself to operating paper mill, and because of that, countryside where it was placed became rich. But at the same time, his family was scattered, because of the constant separation. After becoming an adult, Xu Jia Fu personally demolished his father's paper mill in order to reunite his parents and push the whole family, to back into their hometown. After becoming the secretary of Xujia Datang Village, he was determined to lead the villagers to open up a road of rural revitalization, and after experiencing the "disaster" such as the scam of the new agricultural tourism project and the pig farm disease, the confused and helpless Xu Jia Fu regained confidence under the guidance and encouragement of secretary Zheng Ben Kun.

name: Teresa Teng
summary: The story begins with the unexpected situation of the concert in Shanghai in 2008. Lying on a stretcher, the third brother, Deng Changfu, recalled that on the morning of the early winter of 1953, the fourth child of the Deng family, "the girl", was born in the village of Taiwan's family. The girl's talent in singing appeared when she was young, but her father, Deng Shu, firmly opposed it. Deng Shu retired from the army and began his career as a market stall. The girl was puzzled by the depression and homesickness in her father's heart, but she became a little helper for her father to sell steamed buns. After graduating from primary school, the girl was not admitted to junior high school. However, winning the singing competition through the radio has become a regular shift for singing programmes. Deng Shu clashed with hooligans at the market stall, was beaten and injured, and went into a lawsuit. Late at night, the couple felt that all this was due to the lack of a fixed store. The girl listened in her ear, loved her parents, became a signed singer and paid in advance, and used the money to top the store for her father. Deng Shu was moved when he knew. The girl finally made it to the stage and got countless good reviews.

name: My Knight Boyfiend
summary: Liu Jia Dong and Zhang Ran met each other on the banks of the beautiful Fuchun River, only to later meet again as heiress of the Summit Group and hired bodyguard. Little did these two know at first meet all the hardships and feelings they would have to go through and overcome together.

name: Hjälp vi har köpt en bondgård!
summary: Brita Zackari and Kalle Zackari Wahlström have long dreamed of changing lives, leaving all anxiety and stress in the city and moving to the country with the family. And now the dream has come true: Brita and Kalle have bought a small farm.

previousepisode.name: Då märkte jag att jag inte var vid mina sinnes fulla bruk

name: Dicas de um Sedutor
summary: Santiago Ortiz is a sentimental consultant who works by giving advice for people to win over their loved one or improve their relationships in crisis. He counts on the help of his assistant, Arlete, with whom he lives in friction due to the unorthodox techniques taught for the art of conquest. Ironically, Santiago's daughter, Ganesha is a teenager who is always falling out of love and does not accept her father's advice as she considers it false, resorting to the help of her best friend, Ferrinho, who knows less about romance than she does.

name: Wheel of Fortune
summary: Iconic game show Wheel of Fortune returns as contestants once again spin to win. In this thrilling game of skill and luck, the turn of the wheel secures a cash value before they pick a letter to help them solve the puzzle. For every correct letter they reveal in the puzzle they win multiples of that amount. The pressure is on as they could lose everything at a spin of a wheel which contains ‘bankrupts' and ‘lose a turn' and the contestants' entire winnings could be wiped out.

name: Kim vs Kanye: The Divorce
summary: An insider account of the divorce of Kim Kardashian and Kanye West, revealed by the lawyers involved and the couple's friends. Told from both perspectives, it looks at why Kanye fought to save the marriage but why Kim was desperate to end it.

name: Days with Ambition and Pride
summary: The story of Kang Benshan and Wang Ranqiu in the early days of the founding of New China. They were workers in the Changxindian railway factory who grew up in the bottom "mouth" and "seam" of the ancient town of Changxindian in southwest Beijing.

name: Lava-Lava!
summary: Lava-Lava! is a french slapstick animation series by Federico Vitali from 1995. It contains a pilot and 13 episodes of about 3min each. The main characters of the short stories are animals, humans or aliens. They go through bizarre situations ending frequently out-of-control and violently. Lava-Lava! uses many slapstick elements and get along without spoken words.

name: Kaalkoot
summary: Portrays the life of a determined police officer trying to bust an acid attack case while juggling his work-life balance.

name: Бар «Один звонок»
summary: In the One Call bar, anyone can call a deceased loved one by agreeing to a deadly game of Russian roulette. Investigator Andrei Morozov is looking for his missing son, and all the evidence leads to a mysterious bar that appears in different places, leaving behind the bodies of dead patrons.

name: Тайга
summary: In a small town, there are mysterious murders of girls from dysfunctional families. Investigator Demidov, investigating this case, promises himself to find the maniac, since he himself has two daughters. However, after some time, he discovers that the maniac is much closer to his family than it might have been expected.

name: INSiDE
summary: A reclusive tech expert attempts to shut the world out during the coronavirus lockdown, until a ghost from her past forces her to face reality.

name: El otro lado
summary: Nacho Nieto, a journalist specializing in the paranormal, is going through his worst professional and personal moment. After a failed suicide attempt, he comes back to life accompanied by the ghost of his mentor, Doctor Estrada, a legendary mystery communicator who died more than 20 years ago. At that moment, a virulent poltergeist case, perhaps the most important paranormal case in recent years, crosses his life.

name: Золотое дно
summary: A multimillion-dollar corporation remains without a leader, and a big squabble begins. The family of the oligarch Gradov, his sworn business partner and his mistress start a war for inheritance. Everything is used: espionage, blackmail, seduction, threats, intrigue... The further you go, the harder it is to stop. Now it's not just a business, but a personal matter for all heirs who lose the line between enemies and their own. You can't trust anyone here anymore.

name: ЭКСТРА Такси
summary: The winner of the "Battle of Psychics" Vlad Cherevaty got behind the wheel of a city taxi and picks up random passengers. During a short trip, he will tell something about them that will shock both themselves and the audience.

name: Kazama Kimichika: Kyojo Zero
summary: Kimichika Kazama works as a detective instructor. Through a system called "Kazama Dojo," a rookie detective is paired with Kimichika Kazama and they investigate an actual murder case together. The rookie detective learns techniques used by Kimichika Kazama , while they work on the murder case.

name: BreakTudo Awards
summary: BreakTudo Awards is a Brazilian award designed to honor music, television and internet artists.

name: Amos, Chasseur de Masques
summary: A comedy adventure series set in a magical, medieval fantasy world where myths and legends come to life. A race that will affect the balance of the world is at play: Amos Daragon versus Black Sun.

name: Club Friday The Series 7: Online Love
summary: Ae lives happily with her husband and her daughter, but it all falls apart when she finds out he had an affair with a co-worker. After getting divorced, Ae decides to start a new life and work hard to raise her daughter, but deep down, she feels lonely. So she slipped into the world of online games. In the beginning, her ID was of a woman, but after so many guys started to hit on her, she changed her ID in the game to a man. One day, a girl called Roong started chatting with her, but Ae never told her she was a woman. The relationship between them became more intimate. What's going to happen when Roong finds out the truth?

name: The Amazing Adrenalini Brothers
summary:
"Bakaboo Adrenalini!"

Make way for Xan, Adi and Enk – three death-defying, unitarded daredevils – as they embark on their epic world tour. Their mission: To perform the biggest, craziest stunts EVER.

No fear! No limits!… No chance it won't end in chaos!

name: The Gifted Housekeeper
summary:
Lin Xiao Pan's parents divorced when she was a child, and after that, she went to Japan with her father to study, and graduated from Japan Junior College majoring in home economics. She seems to be silly and sweet, but in reality it's opposite- she's a stubborn and enthusiastic girl with a sense of justice. Her father dotes on his daughter and runs a Chinese restaurant in Japan.

Xiao Pan wanted to marry her boyfriend Zhou Zhi Wei, regardless of his father's opposition and his poor social background. But she didn't expect that he will run off, hearing about it. Wanting to start anew, Xiao Pan comes to Shanghai, and accidentally took over the job of cleaning the building, which starts her career as a housekeeper. Soon , she meets Zuo Fei, grieving lost of his wife, and they both starts to being closer.

name: A Love Story of Different Dimensions
summary: Da Shuai, a naturally optimistic and carefree guy, was accidentally struck by lightning and inexplicably found himself in a parallel dimension. To his surprise, he brought back Xiao Rou, an accountant from the other dimension, to his own home. In a state of shock, these two single individuals from completely different timelines gradually develop feelings for each other through extreme struggles. Will their love eventually conquer the barriers of their separate dimensions?

name: My Charming Villian Emperor
summary: The story of Qiao Qing Qing, a second-year forensic student, who accidentally encounters System Xiao Yi and becomes a script traveler. While on a mission to an unknown script, she becomes trapped inside and meets Yan Jun Huai, a character in the script.

name: The Elegant Empire
summary: A love story between a woman and a man who take revenge to recover neglected justice and lost families.

name: Game of Bros
summary: Get ready for a whole lot of hunks coming straight to your living room as Game of Bros returns for another exciting season. Your favourite comedians ‘Pani and Pani' are joined by new Games Master, Wairangi Koopu. They hold all the power as they sort the bro's from the boys and search Aotearoa for the ultimate Polynesian warrior. The gruelling challenges are taken to all new heights this season, featuring tikanga and reo of a raft of different indigenous cultures for the follow-up series of the world's first inter-Island challenge of cultural skills and heritage knowledge. What set of muscles is going to be sent packing this week?

name: Прелесть
summary: A young car thief named Gypsy cannot forget his father's death. He wants to take revenge on the perpetrators, but does not know who they are, because 20 years have passed since the death. One day, Leonid Maksimovich, the former director of the local plant, appears in the city. This meeting becomes fateful for both.

name: ГДР
summary: 1989-1990 General Secretary of the CPSU Mikhail Gorbachev begins global transformations in the USSR. He passionately desires to become a star of world politics and for this he is ready to go towards the West as far as he likes. But the restructuring he conceived led to fatal, irreversible consequences. First, the Warsaw bloc of socialist countries collapsed, followed by the collapse of the Soviet Union.

name: Кибер Иван
summary: Ivan is an actor and starred in various films. However, his life changes drastically when he breaks his engineer father's latest android, made in his image. Ivan is ready to transform into a robot so as not to set up his parent.

name: Missing Kenley
summary: On 21 September 1992, Kenley Matheson-a 20-year-old first-year Acadia University student-disappeared from Wolfville, Nova Scotia, without a trace. No eyewitnesses came forward. No body was found. No suspects emerged, and no leads surfaced. For three decades, investigators and private detectives hired by the family have been stumped.

name: Taelgia
summary: When Gabriel moves to a million program area in Södertälje, he meets Marko, who is king of the spring ice creams. Marko takes Gabriel on and soon a friendship develops before Gabriel has time to understand how dangerous it is. When a spectacular mistake is made, anger is created higher up in the criminal hierarchy. Taelgia tells the story of families, police and criminals caught in a crossfire of loyalties, demands and guilt in the same area.

name: Club Friday The Series 8: True Love... or Hope
summary: A female fashion designer falls for model Kate, who marries a mutual male friend in order to get pregnant. But will Kate return to her as promised?

name: Club Friday The Series 5: Secret of an Unreal Heart
summary: The story is about Boss and the self-discovery of his burgeoning homosexuality and how he dealt with the various people that entered and exited his life, including members of his family. This drama also chronicles Boss' first same-sex relationship with Win, whom he met online and later on had a long-distance affair with. Boss struggles to cling on to this relationship as he also tries to deal with his sick mother, his cheating father and his useless siblings.

name: Extra Ekstrand
summary: Erik Ekstrand takes the pulse of some of the contemporary current phenomena.

name: Runs Good
summary: Runs Good – Across the US, millions of project cars lay unfinished up on blocks or under tarps. Dan Brockett, Shea Seefeldt and Aaron Parker are on a mission to rescue those broken cars.

previousepisode.name: Celebrating the LS V-8-Powered Subaru LSTI

name: made in Südwest
summary: Documentary series that presents successful companies, initiatives and family businesses from the southwest of Germany.

previousepisode.name: Mähdrescher mit Köpfchen – Die schlauen Landmaschinen aus der Pfalz

name: Nigel Owens: Wyt Ti'n Gêm?
summary: Hidden camera series, with Nigel Owens traveling the country to find out "who's game"

name: Ein Byd Bach Ni
summary: A program for children where we visit countries around the world to learn about the history, food, landscape, children and the culture there.

name: Gauntlet of Gaymes
summary: In this bizarre and fast-paced game show, queer celebrieis participate in a series of four hilarious games that challenge their talent, mental, and physical fitness. Hosted by Michael Henry, the Gauntlet of Gaymes is a silly and unpredictable way to see your favorite queer celebrities like you've never seen them before.

name: Beyond the Headlines: The Series
summary: Beyond the Headlines: The Series explores shocking true crime cases that made national headlines through interviews with survivors, investigators and experts.

name: The Real Wild West
summary: A four-part series revealing the real history of the Wild West. Beyond gunslingers and lawmen, we meet the diverse pioneers who shaped a country. From Black and Hispanic cowboys, female homesteaders, immigrants, and tribal leaders.

name: Грешницы на перевоспитании
summary:
"Sinners on re-education" is a reality show in which 8 escorts and kept women want to change, regain themselves and stop "loving" men for money. In order to improve, they go to a monastery for a month and come out of it new.

"Sinners on re-education" is the most provocative and confessional reality show this fall on the channel "Yu".

name: Сердце Клавы
summary: A romantic reality show in which Klava Coca will try to find the man of her dreams. The main matchmaker of the country, Rosa Sabitova, and blogger Roman Kagramanov will help her in this.

name: Жизнь после шоу. Беременна в 16
summary: A new talk show on the Yu TV channel in which former participants of the reality show "Pregnant at 16" will talk about how their life turned out after the project. The leading actors of the project, actor and TV presenter Oscar Kucera, as well as psychologist Victoria Dmitrieva will help to understand the most acute topics, unexpected twists of fate and life vicissitudes. Young mothers will be given advice and told about their experience by star guests and invited experts. All the most interesting things that happen to the participants of the reality show "Pregnant at 16" can be seen in the project "Life after the show.B16"

name: The General's Sweety
summary: Chef Li Lan accidentally enters the world of the comic The General's Sweety and forms a bond with the cold General Wang Jin. In order to repay the debt left by Li Lan's father, the two open a restaurant together. Li Lan's modern marketing methods and exquisite culinary skills lead to the expansion of their business. They not only clear the debt but also become the wealthiest individuals in Qingshui County.

name: Love from Divorce
summary: An accident caused Wen Lan to lose her memory, and she ended up marrying Mu Bai under her family's introduction. However, their relationship became distant and filled with grievances after marriage. But when an unexpected event occurred, Wen Lan regained her lost memories and made the decisive choice to divorce Mu Bai, pursuing her own path in scientific research. Surprisingly, Mu Bai, faced with a completely different Wen Lan, started feeling a subtle reluctance and unconsciously delayed the divorce proceedings. It was only when Wen Lan moved out of Mu Bai's house and focused on her potion research that they finally divorced. It was at this moment that Mu Bai realized his love for Wen Lan and embarked on a relentless pursuit to win her back...

name: Hot Haus
summary: A group of queer folks live together and compete in a series of sexy challenges to decide who will be named the next queer sex symbol.

name: Gogo for the Gold
summary: From the producers of "Hey Qween" comes GOGO FOR THE GOLD: The Search For ‘America's #1 Champion Gogo Superstar Star.'

name: Holly Stars: Inspirational
summary: Holly Stars, an Icon like no other, finds inspiration in the mundane in this off-beat Mockumentary, whilst waiting for her husband Gary to get released from prison.

name: Пять копеек
summary: On April 19, 1970, the first five "Zhiguli" came off the assembly line of AVTOVAZ. Over the next 18 years, the plant will produce almost 5 million "kopecks", but the first five were special: after all, the plant mechanic hid several kilograms of gold in the gas tank of one of these cars. Only fifty years later, a group of adventurers learns the story of the treasure and is inspired by the treasure hunt. They get to the very first "Zhiguli" exhibited in the museum, but they find nothing. Instead, they find out that the other four cars still exist, and set off in pursuit of gold, unaware that they are actually looking for themselves and their way of life.

name: Shi Fang Jian Sheng
summary: In the world of "Shifang Tianyu" where strength reigns supreme, a young martial artist named Lin Tian finds himself deceived by his betrothed, Xiao Yun, and the treacherous eldest son of the esteemed Mo family, Mo Sen. They cunningly swindle him of his family's fortune and push him off a treacherous cliff. Miraculously surviving, Lin Tian awakens with a newfound determination to seek justice and reclaim his rightful inheritance. Fate smiles upon him as he discovers a mysterious black iron sword hidden beneath the cliff's depths, possessing mystical powers that aid him in his journey towards mastering the unparalleled martial arts...(Cgpt)

name: The Traitors NZ
summary: The Traitors NZ, hosted by Madeleine Sami, is the hit psychological strategy game with more twists and betrayals. Follow the cast of 21 Kiwi players as they compete with their eyes on the rising prize money.

name: Confucious was a Foodie
summary: In this new six-part TV documentary series, celebrity Chef Christine Cushing eats, cooks and explores her way through traditional Chinese cuisines as they are found in North America.

name: Primal Survivor Extreme African Safari
summary: In this part of Hazen Audel's extreme African safari, he takes on the mighty Lake Baringo. His goal is to witness millions of migratory flamingos.

name: Hollywood's Hottest Hunks
summary: Who has the hottest body? Who has the best dancing skills? Who's the cutest dad? Or who makes you laugh the most? The hottest on-screen kiss to the best shirtless snapshots or who makes the perfect husband? From dashing new boys on the block to classic Hollywood charmers.

name: Que Te Perdone Dios... Yo No
Vuxna människor
summary: 30-year-old Mathilda is on the verge of the perfect adulthood with a job at a law firm and a stable relationship. But when her boyfriend proposes, an avalanche of emotions lead to questionable actions and put Mathilda's entire life in jeopardy.

name: Why R U?
summary: Lee Won and Ji Oh are two beings from a different world. Ever since the university admission, their persistent enemy-like relationship has continued. Less did they know that those two would end up in a BL novel. Embarrassed by the unexpected remark of his younger sister and BL writer, Lee Jin, Lee Won makes an unusual oath. Either it's the curse of the BL novel, but he and Ji Oh have become partners in an acting class. Ji Oh is strangely obsessed with bullying Lee Won. As he keeps getting involved with the person he wants to avoid, Lee Won believes that the BL novel is turning into reality. Sun Woo resents the news of Do Yeon and Yu Gyeom dating. Sun Woo drunk called him when Yu Gym didn't show up at Do Yeon's birthday party. Somehow, he wakes up the next day and finds Yu Gyeom in the same bed.

name: Infamia
summary: After years of living in the UK, a teenage Roma girl Gita and her family move back to their native Poland. After returning, the girl tries to find herself and discovers her passions, at the same time trying to live the life of a normal 17-year-old. But when she falls in love, she will have to balance the modern world of teenagers and traditional family rules.

name: Цикады
summary: Anton and Alina, Mark and Sonya, Alex and Katya are yesterday's schoolchildren who are just starting to live as adults, fall in love, dream, make plans for the future, until a terrible tragedy happens at a party. Now they, their parents and the investigator need to restore the picture of what happened. The further the interrogation goes, the more problems and secrets are revealed. Teenagers are confused and scared, and parents are wondering: did they know their children well at all?

name: My Fake Wife
summary: Xia Miaomiao is forced as her sister's substitute to marry Leng Zhixing, the second son of the Leng family, known as a fierce, disabled bully. After they get married, as they spend time together, they grow fond of each other. However, Leng Zhixing accidentally finds that Xia Miaomiao's birth mother was the driver who caused the car accident back then. In the face of past grudges, how will their relationship go?

name: Love Forever Young
summary: The ethereal Yanshan Mountain has two major sects - the Yanshan Sect consisting of male disciples and the Baihua Sect consisting of female disciples. Despite living close to each other, the two sects rarely interact due to their strict rules. However, nothing can hinder the yearning for love among the young disciples, leading to a series of intricate and joyful stories.

name: 6ixtynin9 The Series
summary: After losing her job, a woman discovers a mysterious package on her apartment doorstep — and her life takes a turn for the worse.

name: Alice & Jack
summary: When Alice and Jack first meet they're bound by a connection so powerful it seems nothing can break it, but will their path lead them to a place of happiness and togetherness? Or will life and their own emotional complexities get in the way? Honest, intimate, and surprisingly funny, Alice & Jack shows love in all its unexpected, technicolour, kaleidoscopic beauty.
